defect: none; asynchronous enable is synchronized and only applied to the gate while the clock is low
rationale: The enable output is a two-flop synchronized view. A separate falling-edge register controls the clock gate, so changes to the asynchronous enable cannot truncate a high clock phase.

mutation.description: Reduced prim_clock_gating_sync to its enable synchronizer and falling-edge gate latch.
